entries.zh: 把一物叠放在另一物之上；摞起
entries.en: to put one thing on top of another; to stack up
to put up high; to pile up high
to put away out of sight; to stow by stacking

entries.zh: 夹放于中间；夹入（作标记）
entries.en: to place in between; to interpose (as a marker)

entries.notes: source_L 末词 cagar 疑为 cazar／echar 之讹；H「常網」字面与 M「hung hǎng」未完全对应，义依渔网语境定。

entries.en: to put aside; to set on one side
entries.notes: H 首字「廿」与 M「xỳ」不协，疑为「棄／擲」类字草写；「放一邊」一节三栏可通。

entries.en: to put in some place; to set down somewhere

entries.zh: 为文书契据订定期限；约定日期
entries.en: to set a term/deadline for a written document; to fix a date
entries.notes: L 就文书之期限而言，H／M 作「定日子」，取约定日期之义，义近而微差。

entries.en: to get on all fours; to stand on four legs
entries.notes: H「控處」与 M「câng zě」未能互证，释义暂依 source_L。
M 栏末尾混入西语「la luna」，系原稿双语夹注，非另一音读。

entries.en: to put on the banquín (the hairnet tied over the topknot)
entries.notes: Banquín 系西语记音借词，H「結網巾」示其所指为束发网巾。

entries.zh: 十五岁戴网巾成丁；成年（行冠礼）
entries.en: to take the banquín at fifteen; to come of age

entries.notes: M 栏「L.」当为「lo mismo」之省，重出 sáy，非新词。

entries.en: «por» of place: through, along, by way of
entries.notes: 全页仅此条填 R 栏（càng）；「按」表依循、经由，故定为处所介词。

entries.zh: 「por」表原因与目的：为了、因着（为某人、为帮扶）
entries.en: «por» causal and final: for the sake of, on account of, in order to favour

entries.notes: H「引」作原因介词罕见，与上条「爲」并列重出；M「ín」与 H 相合，姑从原栏。
